{
  "agents": [
    {
      "imageName": "gluesync-mssql-cdc",       // maps to Docker image
      "nickname": "custom-mssql-target",       // custom name for container 
      "type": "target",                        // source or target (required for processing)
      "tag": "2.1.2.6",                        // optional image version tag
      "environment": {                         // env variables in service
        "NODE_ENV": "production",
        "DB_HOST": "db",
        "DB_USER": "root",
        "DB_PASS": "password",
        "privileged": true,
        "start_from": 0
      },
      "labels": {                              // docker-compose labels
        "team": "data-eng",
        "stage": "prod"
      },
      "ports": [                               // port mappings
        "9090:9090",
        "9090:9091",
        "8080:80"
      ],
      "volumes": [                             // volume mounts
        "./data:/var/lib/mysql",
        "./logs:/var/log/mssql"
      ],
      "reservations": {                        // resource reservations
        "cpus": 1.0,
        "memory": "2.0G"
      },
      "limits": {                              // resource limits
        "cpus": 2.0,
        "memory": "6.4G"
      }
    },
    {
      "imageName": "gluesync-mssql-cdc",       // maps to Docker image
      "nickname": "custom-mssql-source",  
      "type": "source",                        // source or target (required for processing)
      "tag": "2.1.2.6",                        // optional image version tag
      "environment": {                         // env variables in service
        "NODE_ENV": "production",
        "DB_HOST": "db",
        "DB_USER": "root",
        "DB_PASS": "password",
        "privileged": true,
        "start_from": 0
      },
      "labels": {                              // docker-compose labels
        "team": "data-eng",
        "stage": "prod"
      },
      "ports": [                               // port mappings
        "9090:9090",
        "9090:9091",
        "8080:80"
      ],
      "volumes": [                             // volume mounts
        "./data:/var/lib/mysql",
        "./logs:/var/log/mssql"
      ],
      "reservations": {                        // resource reservations
        "cpus": 1.0,
        "memory": "2.0G"
      },
      "limits": {                              // resource limits
        "cpus": 2.0,
        "memory": "6.4G"
      }
    }
  ]
}
